candidate.definition_en: Causing or able to cause death; extremely effective or dangerous.
candidate.explanation_ar: مميت أو قاتل؛ يصف ما يسبب الموت أو ما هو بالغ الخطورة والدقة.

senses.definition_en: Causing or likely to cause death.
examples: The poison is deadly to rats.
The virus proved to be deadly in many cases.

senses.definition_ar: شديد الدقة أو الفعالية أو التأثير.
examples: His accuracy with the bow was deadly.
The poison is deadly to rats.
The virus proved to be deadly in many cases.
His accuracy with the bow was deadly.
candidate.mnemonic: مشتقة مباشرة من كلمة Dead (ميت)؛ أي شيء deadly يجعلك dead.
